title: LC-MS Sample Prep: Standards/Calibration Curves/Patient Samples
author: Opentrons
materials: Make a 1:2 dilution series of unlabeled standards.
Distribute Golden Plasma to sample tubes.
Combine unlabelled standard, NEM, labeled standard.

steps.title: Make dilution series of unlabeled standards
steps.instruction: Create a 1:2 dilution series of the unlabeled standards.

steps.title: Prepare labeled standards solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a solution of the labeled standards.

steps.title: Distribute Golden Plasma to tubes
steps.instruction: Add Golden Plasma to each sample tube.

steps.title: Combine reagents
steps.instruction: Combine the unlabelled standard, N‑ethyl‑maleimide (NEM), and labeled standard in each tube.

steps.title: Add TFA in acetonitrile
steps.instruction: Add trifluoroacetic acid (TFA) dissolved in acetonitrile to the mixture.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to filters
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to Amicon filters.

steps.title: Centrifuge and dry filters
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filters and allow drying (pause for centrifugation and drying).

steps.title: Resuspend in acetonitrile‑water
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried material in a mixture of acetonitrile and water.
